strengths.title: Exceptional Survivability
strengths.description: Heavy armour, ERA, shields, and a placable barrier combine to make the FV4030 one of the toughest tanks to remove from a position. This tank has staying power above all others of its class. Keep your front head on and enemies will be hard pressed to remove you quickly.

strengths.title: Objective Control
strengths.description: The FV4030 excels at locking down capture points and advtangeous positions, thus forcing enemies to commit significant resources to dislodging it. Players should seek to position themselves on approaches to objectives to distrupt and control enemy pushes. Players who stick with the HE shell will find they can stall an entire push with ease.

strengths.title: Team Focused Tank
strengths.description: The FV4030 is best played with allies. In a coordinated group this tank is a powerful enabler. It's HE shells act has a hard counter to mobility. Paired with teammates, the FV can direct the fight, keep enemies in place and allow allies to eliminate threats with ease.

strengths.title: Forgiving Playstyle
strengths.description: The FV4030 can be a friendly tank to newcomers. Its durability allows it to absorb mistakes that would prove costly in lighter vehicles. Players will find the ERA useful when caught unaware as the tile will eat the first shot, resulting in zero incoming damage. This allows for a window of reaction for the player to present their best side before followup strikes come.

strengths.title: Alternative build potential
strengths.description: The FV4030 can sport several builds, from entrenching further into its defensive abilities, such as being able to provide passive healing, or switching it up to an offensive build, trading the HE for a powerful AP round with a faster reload. Whatever your playstyle, you will likely find a build to suit you.

weaknesses.title: Low Overall Mobility
weaknesses.description: One of your greatest weaknesses in the FV4030 will be your ability to react. All your armour comes at a price, and that price is movement. The tank is slow, the traverse is slow. If you're caught out, or pushed into a bad position you will not be able to turn and run. Once an FV is in a fight, it is in it until it dies or the fight is won.

weaknesses.title: Reliance on Defensive Systems
weaknesses.description: A lot of the FV4030's staying power comes from its passive ERA and shields alongside its placable Bastion ability. However, these are limited. The longer the engagement lasts and the more incoming fire you take will ultimately lead to you being stripped of much of your survivability. Possibly leaving you weaker when you need it most.

weaknesses.title: Limited Offensive Potential
weaknesses.description: Whilst strong, most of your time in the FV4030 will be spent going from point to point or supporting teammates. Unlike an attacker or a more nimble defender the FV4030 will rarely be able to strike out on its own. Your power comes from your team's support and their survivability comes from you. You can start a push, but will never be the one to finish it.

weaknesses.title: Game mode dependant
weaknesses.description: The FV4030 is absolutely at home on Control or Hardpoint and it is one of the strongest tanks you can take. Although should you find yourself in a kill confirmed gamemode or a larger conquest map you will struggle to stay relevent due to your limited ability to chase the map and the fight.

weaknesses.title: Large Target
weaknesses.description: The FV4030 is a large tank even in it's class. And whilst it has fewer weakspots than others they are obvious, such as the TOGS sight on the right side of your turret or the gaps between the ERA and the Hull. Should you run into an experienced player you may find your toolkit nullified and you will be hard pressed to mitigate the weakness.
